import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("bench/results/environment-narration/t9d-search/smoke")
assert json.loads((base / "spent.json").read_text())["spent_micro_usd"] <= 70000

def route_rows(name, expected_replicates, expected_turns, last_input):
    route_base = base / name / "rows"
    assert (route_base / "rows.json").is_file()
    assert (route_base / "summary.json").is_file()
    rows = json.loads((route_base / "rows.json").read_text())
    summary = json.loads((route_base / "summary.json").read_text())
    assert summary["enforce"] is True
    assert summary.get("shadow", False) is False
    for row in rows:
        for turn in row.get("turns", []):
            for field in ("turn_elapsed_s", "enforce_attempts", "narration_attempts", "observation_request", "engine_opened", "focus_open_state_after", "focus_open_state_committed", "handoff_id", "delivered_text"):
                assert field in turn
    if summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
        assert len(rows) == expected_replicates
        assert all(len(row.get("turns", [])) == expected_turns for row in rows)
        assert all(row["turns"][-1]["input"] == last_input for row in rows)

route_rows("a", 1, 9, "inspect the passenger seat")
a_summary = json.loads((base / "a" / "rows" / "summary.json").read_text())
if a_summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
    route_rows("b", 1, 4, "pull out the drawer")
    b_summary = json.loads((base / "b" / "rows" / "summary.json").read_text())
    if b_summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
        route_rows("c", 2, 6, "look under the drawer")
print("checked t9d routes and spent cap")
PY
